title: Important Update: ICSI Invites Professional Feedback on MCA21-V3 Portal Issues (Deadline: Sept 15, 2026)
content:
# Important Update: ICSI Invites Professional Feedback on MCA21-V3 Portal Issues (Deadline: Sept 15, 2026)

Ek important update hai for all professionals! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne MCA21-V3 Portal par aa rahi issues ko address karne ke liye professional feedback invite kiya hai. This initiative aims to improve the form filing process and address practical difficulties faced by stakeholders.

Here are the key details:

*   **What:** ICSI is collecting feedback on technical glitches, filing challenges, error messages, and other issues encountered while using the MCA21-V3 Portal.
*   **Why:** The goal is to compile these inputs and submit them to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) for necessary action, ensuring a smoother and more user-friendly filing experience.
*   **How to Submit Feedback:** Professionals are requested to submit their feedback through an online form titled "Issues/Feedback on MCA 21-V3 Portal - Fill out form."
*   **Deadline:** The last date for submitting your valuable feedback is **September 15, 2026, by 9 AM**. Don't miss out on this opportunity to contribute to a better compliance ecosystem!

Your active participation will help identify recurring problems and lead to significant improvements in the MCA21-V3 portal.
